探究向心力大小与半径、角速度、质量的关系: How Centripetal Force Depends on Radius, Angular Velocity and Mass
这台手摇的演示器只给你两个标尺上的格数——能不能用它把 F 与 m、r、ω 的定: This hand-cranked demonstrator only gives you the number of divisions showing on two scales. Can you use it to measure how F depends on m, r and ω?
手柄 → 塔轮 → 皮带 → 转盘：两球同速转，或按皮带档倍速转: Crank → stepped pulleys → belt → turntables: the two balls turn at the same speed, or at a multiple set by the belt position
挡板压力 → 横臂杠杆 → 套筒下降 → 标尺露出红白格（一格一格地数）: Force on the stop → lever arm → sleeve drops → scale shows red-and-white divisions (count them one by one)
一次只动 m、r、ω 中的一个，其余两个锁死（控制变量）: Change only one of m, r and ω at a time, locking the other two (controlled variables)
两标尺格数相除 = 两球向心力之比（教材说「粗略」）: Divisions on one scale ÷ the other = ratio of the two balls' centripetal forces (the textbook says "roughly")
三条过原点的直线 → Fn = mω²r = m v²/r: Three straight lines through the origin → Fn = mω²r = m v²/r
蓝底台体、四条腿、两根转轴、手柄: Blue base, four legs, two spindles, crank
三层塔轮 + 皮带，角速度比从这里来: Three-step pulleys + belt; this is where the angular velocity ratio comes from
长槽球、横臂挡板、套筒、标尺: Long-slot ball, lever stop, sleeve, scale
短槽球、横臂挡板、套筒、标尺: Short-slot ball, lever stop, sleeve, scale
这台仪器叫什么？手柄、塔轮、长槽、横臂、套筒、标尺各干什么？为什么读出来的是「格: What is this instrument called? What do the crank, stepped pulleys, long slot, lever arm, sleeve and scale each do? Why does it read "divisions" rather than "newtons"?
拖视角绕实验台看一圈：认清图6.2-4 的 1–8 号部位，顺「手柄 → 塔轮: Drag the view around the bench: identify parts 1–8 in Fig. 6.2-4 and follow "crank → stepped pulleys → belt → turntables → balls → stops → sleeves → scales"
默认工况（等质量、两球都 4.0 cm、皮带 I、60 r/min）：两盘同速转: Default setup (equal masses, both balls at 4.0 cm, belt I, 60 r/min): both turntables turn at the same speed, the left scale shows 8 divisions and the right shows 8, a ratio of 1.00.
小球做匀速圆周运动，向心力由横臂挡板对球的压力提供；球对挡板的反作用经杠杆使套筒: Each ball moves in uniform circular motion, with the centripetal force supplied by the push of the lever stop on the ball; the ball's reaction on the stop works through the lever to lower the sleeve and reveal the scale. Textbook p.29: "from the red-and-white equal divisions exposed on the scales, the ratio of the centripetal forces on the two balls can be roughly calculated". This instrument gives a ratio, not how many newtons each force is.
facts A2.5、A2.6、A5.1、A6；图6.2-4（p.29）、p.2: facts A2.5, A2.6, A5.1, A6; Fig. 6.2-4 (p.29), wording from pp.28–29; B3.2
八个部位各有分工：手柄给转速、塔轮给角速度比、长槽给半径、横臂挡板给压力、套筒与: Each of the eight parts has a job: the crank sets the speed, the stepped pulleys the angular velocity ratio, the long slot the radius, the lever stop the force, and the sleeve and scale turn force into divisions. The numbers on the labels (crank 1, long slot 4, short slot 5, stepped pulleys 2·3) are the part numbers in textbook Fig. 6.2-4, not scale marks or settings.
读的是比值不是牛顿：教材自己写「粗略计算出两个球所受向心力的比值」，标尺只能数整: It reads a ratio, not newtons: the textbook itself says "roughly calculate the ratio of the centripetal forces on the two balls", and the scale can only count whole divisions.
向心力不是第四种力：这里是「挡板对球的压力」，别在图上再加一条向外的「离心力」。: Centripetal force isn't a fourth kind of force: here it's "the push of the stop on the ball", so don't add an outward "centrifugal force" to the diagram.
去掉这一步：学生不知道 8 格是什么意思，后面所有读数都成了黑箱。: Skip this step and students don't know what 8 divisions means, and every later reading is a black box.
器材辨认 + 「向心力按效果命名」（课标 p.16「会使用所提供的实验器材进行实: Identifying equipment + "centripetal force is named for its effect" (curriculum standard p.16: "use the equipment provided to carry out experiments and obtain data"; textbook p.27).
为什么要先把两球调成「同质量、同半径、同角速度」？这时两个标尺应该露得一样多，露: Why first set both balls to "same mass, same radius, same angular velocity"? The two scales should then show the same amount; what does it mean if they don't?
把两球、长槽、皮带逐项调回同一工况：等质量、都 4.0 cm、皮带 I: Set the balls, long slot and belt back to the same setup one by one: equal masses, both at 4.0 cm, belt I
不匹配的起点（长槽 6.0 cm + 皮带 II）：左 12 格、右 32 格，: Mismatched start (long slot 6.0 cm + belt II): left 12 divisions, right 32, ratio 0.38; the right ball turns twice as fast and its scale stands much higher. With all four matched: 8 to 8 divisions, ratio 1.00, both scales level.
教材 p.29 的实验是两球同时转、同时读，所以任何一个量不一样，读出来的就不是: In the experiment on textbook p.29 both balls turn and are read at the same time, so if any one quantity differs, the reading isn't the effect of that one quantity alone; only when all four match and the scales are level (ratio 1.00) is the instrument "set up". This is the premise for the next three steps.
facts A2.6、A2.19、A2.21、A7.7；B3.2；标准值表 A、: facts A2.6, A2.19, A2.21, A7.7; B3.2; standard values tables A, D, F
演示器是两球同时转、同时读的仪器：任何一个量不同，标尺差就不是「那个量」的功劳。: The demonstrator spins and reads both balls at once: if any quantity differs, the scale difference isn't due to "that one quantity".
「仪器自检」= 四项对齐（同质量、同半径、同角速度、同转速），判据是两标尺等高（: "Self-check" = all four matched (same mass, radius, angular velocity, speed), and the test is level scales (ratio 1.00).
手柄要匀速转（教材 p.28 原句），转速抖的时候套筒会自己上下动。: Turn the crank steadily (textbook p.28 wording); if the speed wobbles, the sleeves bob up and down by themselves.
去掉这一步：后面三步读到的比值都掺着别的变量，结论全是假的。: Skip this step and the ratios in the next three steps are mixed with other variables, making every conclusion false.
必考：控制变量的前置对齐与「两标尺同高」这个判据。: Exam must-know: aligning everything before controlling variables, and the test "both scales level".
m比 = r比 = ω比 = 1: m ratio = r ratio = ω ratio = 1
只换球、别的都不动：露出的格数会翻倍吗？为什么不能同时把球挪远一点？: Change only the balls, nothing else: do the divisions double? Why can't you move a ball outward at the same time?
按「记录一组」记 3 组：左小右大 / 等质量 / 左大右小（别的都不动）: Press "Record" for 3 sets: small left/large right / equal masses / large left/small right (nothing else changed)
三组（左球在 4.0 cm、皮带 I、60 r/min，只改球）：质量比 0.5: Three sets (left ball at 4.0 cm, belt I, 60 r/min, only the balls changed): mass ratio 0.50 → 8 / 16 divisions → 0.50; 1.00 → 8 / 8 → 1.00; 2.00 → 16 / 8 → 2.00. The three points lie on a line through the origin, slope 1.000.
只改质量时，格数比等于质量比 ⟹ F ∝ m。教材 p.29 那句提问「怎样才能: Changing only mass, the division ratio equals the mass ratio ⟹ F ∝ m. The textbook's question on p.29, "how can you keep other quantities fixed while changing one?", is answered here: the balls change, and neither the radius setting nor the belt setting may move.
facts A2.7、A2.9、A2.14；必修一 p.92；标准值表 B、C、: facts A2.7, A2.9, A2.14; Required Book 1 p.92; standard values tables B, C, table B (mass row)
判定「只改了一个量」：半径档、皮带档、转速档一个都不许动。: Check that "only one quantity changed": don't touch the radius, belt or speed settings.
三组要落在过原点的直线上（斜率 1.000），不是「看起来一样」。: The three sets must lie on a line through the origin (slope 1.000), not just "look the same".
质量翻倍、格数翻倍 ⟹ F ∝ m（一次方）。: Double the mass, double the divisions ⟹ F ∝ m (first power).
去掉这一步：Fn = mω²r 里的 m 就是背下来的。: Skip this step and the m in Fn = mω²r is just memorized.
Exam must-know: controlled variables + proportionality from a line through the origin (textbook p.29's question + the method on Required Book 1 p.92).
把长槽的球挪到 6.0 cm、8.0 cm，格数会变几倍？是跟半径成正比，还是跟: Move the long-slot ball to 6.0 cm and 8.0 cm. By what factor do the divisions change? Is it proportional to radius, or to radius squared?
把长槽的球从 4.0 cm 挪到 6.0 cm（12 格）再挪到 8.0 cm（: Move the long-slot ball from 4.0 cm to 6.0 cm (12 divisions), then to 8.0 cm (16 divisions)
等质量、皮带 I、60 r/min，只挪长槽：半径比 1.00 → 8 格 /: Equal masses, belt I, 60 r/min, only the long slot moved: radius ratio 1.00 → 8 / 8 divisions → 1.00; 1.50 (6.0 cm) → 12 / 8 → 1.50; 2.00 (8.0 cm) → 16 / 8 → 2.00. The left ball's linear speed at the same moment is 0.251 / 0.377 / 0.503 m/s.
只改半径时，格数比等于半径比 ⟹ F ∝ r（一次方，不是平方）；半径翻倍、力也: Changing only radius, the division ratio equals the radius ratio ⟹ F ∝ r (first power, not squared); double the radius and the force doubles, but the linear speed also doubles (v = ωr), so "F ∝ v²" and "F ∝ r" don't conflict: as v grows, so does r.
facts A2.5、A2.8、A2.11、A2.14；图6.2-4（p.29）: facts A2.5, A2.8, A2.11, A2.14; Fig. 6.2-4 (p.29); standard values tables D, E
半径是一次方：8.0 cm 比 4.0 cm 远一倍，格数也只多一倍。: Radius is first power: 8.0 cm is twice as far as 4.0 cm, and the divisions only double.
同一时刻线速度也变了（v = ωr），所以「F 与 v 的平方成正比」和「F 与: The linear speed changes at the same time (v = ωr), so "F proportional to v squared" and "F proportional to r" aren't two separate things.
长槽上三档刻线要对准球心，球的位置就是半径。: The three marks on the long slot line up with the ball's center; the ball's position is the radius.
去掉这一步：学生会把 r 也当成平方关系，mω²r 记成 mω²r²。: Skip this step and students treat r as squared too, writing mω²r as mω²r².
必考：半径的幂次（一次方）、v = ωr 的联动。: Exam must-know: the power of radius (first), and how v = ωr links them.
皮带从同层挪到差一层、差两层，右球转得快了 2 倍、3 倍——格数会变 2 倍、: Move the belt from the same step to one step apart, then two: the right ball turns 2 and 3 times as fast. Do the divisions change 2 and 3 times?
按「记录一组」记 3 组：皮带 I / II / III（质量与半径不动）: Press "Record" for 3 sets: belt I / II / III (mass and radius unchanged)
三组（等质量、都 4.0 cm、60 r/min）：皮带 I → 8 / 8 →: Three sets (equal masses, both at 4.0 cm, 60 r/min): belt I → 8 / 8 → 1.00; II (ω ratio 2) → 8 / 32 → 0.25; III (ω ratio 3) → 8 / 72 → 0.11 (= 1/9 = 0.1111 to two decimals). Through-origin slope 1.000.
右球角速度变 2 倍，向心力变 4 倍；变 3 倍，变 9 倍 ⟹ F ∝ ω²: Double the right ball's angular velocity and the centripetal force quadruples; triple it and the force is nine times ⟹ F ∝ ω² (not ω to the first power). Exercise 3 on textbook p.26, "friction drive without slipping → ω is inversely proportional to r", is where the 1:2:3 pulley ratio in this step comes from.
facts A2.12、A2.8、A2.14；图6.2-4（p.29）、p.26: facts A2.12, A2.8, A2.14; Fig. 6.2-4 (p.29), p.26 exercise 3; standard values tables F, G
塔轮换层改变的是两侧的角速度比（1 : 2 : 3）；手柄转速对两侧同时变、不产: Changing pulley steps changes the angular velocity ratio between the two sides (1 : 2 : 3); the crank speed changes both sides together and creates no ratio difference.
格数比随 ω 的平方变：2 倍 → 4 倍，3 倍 → 9 倍。: The division ratio changes with ω squared: 2 times → 4 times, 3 times → 9 times.
8/72 = 0.11 就是 1/9；三档读数都是精确的，取整误差只在真实档出现: 8/72 = 0.11 is 1/9; all three readings are exact, and rounding error only appears in real mode (step 7).
去掉这一步：学生会把 F 当成与 ω 成正比，最常见的一条错。: Skip this step and students treat F as proportional to ω, the single most common mistake.
必考：ω 的幂次（平方）、摩擦传动不打滑 ⇒ ω 跟 r 成反比（教材 p.26: Exam must-know: the power of ω (squared); friction drive without slipping ⇒ ω inversely proportional to r (textbook p.26, exercise 3).
三个量合起来该怎么写？三个量同时都不一样，格数比还可能等于 1.00 吗？: How do you write the three together? With all three quantities different at once, can the division ratio still be 1.00?
让三个量的比相乘等于 1：至少两档不是基准，而格数比正好 1.00: Make the product of the three ratios equal 1: at least two settings off baseline, yet the division ratio exactly 1.00
解法之一（大球 + 长槽 8.0 cm + 皮带 II）：质量比 2、半径比 2: One solution (large ball + long slot 8.0 cm + belt II): mass ratio 2, radius ratio 2, angular velocity ratio² 1/4 → product 1 → both sides show 32 divisions, ratio 1.00. Another (large ball on the right + long slot 8.0 cm + belt I): 0.5 × 2 × 1 = 1 → 16 / 16 divisions → 1.00.
三个量合起来就是 Fn = mω²r；用它和 v = ωr 一步换出 Fn =: Put the three together and you get Fn = mω²r; with v = ωr it becomes Fn = m v²/r in one step (the two boxed formulas on textbook p.29). Two different setups can only give the same division ratio if the three quantities' powers are 1, 1 and 2: this is the lesson's strongest evidence.
facts A2.8、A2.11、A2.14、A5.3；图6.2-4（p.29）: facts A2.8, A2.11, A2.14, A5.3; Fig. 6.2-4 (p.29), p.30 exercise 3; standard values tables D, J
三个量合起来：Fn = mω²r，再用 v = ωr 换成 Fn = m v²/: Together the three give Fn = mω²r, which v = ωr turns into Fn = m v²/r (two boxed formulas on the same page, the same law).
「不同工况拼出同一个格数比」是幂次为 1、1、2 的直接证据。: "Different setups giving the same division ratio" is direct evidence that the powers are 1, 1 and 2.
会算教材 p.30 第 3 题：0.10 kg、0.10 m、4 rad/s →: Work out textbook p.30, question 3: 0.10 kg, 0.10 m, 4 rad/s → 0.16 N (the textbook doesn't print the answer; it's calculated from the formula on p.29).
去掉这一步：学生只会分别记三个比例，遇到两条式子一起出题就乱。: Skip this step and students only remember three separate proportions and get confused when both formulas appear in one question.
综合：两条式子互推 + 用教材习题数据算一遍（0.16 N 是习题答案，不是本课: Synthesis: converting between the two formulas + working through the textbook exercise data (0.16 N is the exercise answer, not a reading from this lesson).
皮带脱开时右标尺为什么一格都不露？「真实器材」档打开后格数比为什么变成 0.29: With the belt off, why does the right scale show no divisions at all? With "Real equipment" on, why is the ratio 0.29 instead of 0.25?
先把皮带拨到脱开看一遍（右球不转），再把「真实器材」打开看第二遍（皮带打滑）: First switch the belt off and look (the right ball doesn't turn), then turn on "Real equipment" and look again (the belt slips)
① 皮带脱开：右球不转，右标尺 0 格，格数比「—」；② 真实档（皮带 II，6: ① Belt off: the right ball doesn't turn, the right scale shows 0 divisions, and the ratio is "—"; ② real mode (belt II, 60 r/min): the right scale drops from 32 to 28 divisions (−12.5 %), and the ratio is 0.29 instead of 0.25 (+14.3 %; +13.2 % for the continuous value); ③ over range (120 r/min + belt III): the right scale would need 288 divisions but only has 80, so the sleeve hits its stop and the right reading says "over range".
Belt slip makes the right ball turn slower than nominal → right-side centripetal force too small → ratio too large (the direction is fixed in A2.18 and can be recalculated); the few percent off in the ratio don't mean the law fails; it's the "roughly" the textbook mentions: the scale can only count whole divisions (±0.5 division each side, ratio error bound 0.5/left + 0.5/right).
facts A2.6, A2.18, A7.2, A7.6; B1.1, B1.5, B1.6; standard values tables C, K, L, M
皮带打滑的方向能算：(1/0.94)²−1 = +13.2 %，格数比偏大。: The direction of belt slip can be calculated: (1/0.94)²−1 = +13.2 %, ratio too large.
标尺只能数整格 → 格数比误差上界 0.5/左格数 + 0.5/右格数（8/8: The scale counts whole divisions only → ratio error bound 0.5/left divisions + 0.5/right divisions (12.5 % at 8/8).
转速太高会超量程（右球 288 格 > 80 格），读数作废而不是「偏大」。: Too high a speed goes over range (right ball 288 divisions > 80), and the reading is void, not "too high".
去掉这一步：学生把器材的系统误差当成实验规律，还会拿 1 % 的差别下结论。: Skip this step and students mistake the equipment's systematic error for a law, and draw conclusions from a 1 % difference.
实验素养：说出误差来源与方向（课标 p.16「知道实验存在误差」）。: Lab skills: state error sources and their direction (curriculum standard p.16: "know that experiments have errors").
两球质量相同、半径相同，只动皮带档——用标尺记 3 组，能不能当场判出格数比跟: Two balls of equal mass at equal radius, changing only the belt: can you record 3 sets on the scales and show on the spot that the division ratio is proportional to (angular velocity ratio)²?
只动皮带档记满 3 组（I / II / III），最后停在皮带 III，让判据: Change only the belt setting to record 3 sets (I / II / III), finish on belt III, and keep the test passing for 10 s
达标条件：① 两球同质量；② 长槽回到 4.0 cm（两侧同半径）；③ 当前停在: Pass conditions: ① both balls the same mass; ② long slot back at 4.0 cm (same radius on both sides); ③ currently on belt III; ④ the record table has 3 sets; ⑤ each row's division ratio = (ω ratio)² (tolerance 0.02); ⑥ through-origin fit against (ω ratio)² has slope 1.00 ± 0.10. Valid solution: 8/8 = 1.00, 8/32 = 0.25, 8/72 = 0.11, slope 1.000.
没有新结论：把第 5 步的方法用一遍——只改一个量 + 两标尺格数比 + 过原点: No new conclusion: use step 5's method once more, changing one quantity + division ratio of the two scales + line through the origin. It tests ω squared rather than r to the first power because that's where students most often go wrong (thinking twice as fast means twice the divisions).

考核只动皮带档，质量与半径（4.0 cm）一律不动。: The assessment only changes the belt setting; mass and radius (4.0 cm) stay fixed.
3 组数据要能画出对 (ω比)² 的过原点直线，斜率 ≈ 1。: The 3 sets must give a line through the origin against (ω ratio)², with slope ≈ 1.
皮带 III 那一组读 8 / 72 = 0.11，也就是 1/9 —— 快 3: The belt III set reads 8 / 72 = 0.11, i.e. 1/9: three times as fast, nine times the divisions.
去掉这一步：学生会用「三个量一起调」蒙出一个漂亮数字，也永远记不住 ω 是平方。: Skip this step and students fudge a nice number by "adjusting all three at once", and never remember that ω is squared.
综合考核：控制变量 + 标尺读数 + 过原点斜率，专考最易错的「ω 是平方」。: Comprehensive assessment: controlled variables + scale readings + through-origin slope, targeting the most error-prone point, "ω is squared".
y = x 参照 · 点＝记录 · 虚线＝拟合: y = x reference · dots = records · dashed = fit
只动皮带，判 F ∝ ω²: Change only the belt, show F ∝ ω²
同质量、都 4.0 cm，只改皮带档记 3 组，最后停在皮带 III: Same mass, both at 4.0 cm; change only the belt to record 3 sets, finishing on belt III
两球同质量、同半径，皮带差一层（右球角速度是左球的两倍）。左标尺露 8 格，右标: Two balls of the same mass at the same radius, belt one step apart (the right ball's angular velocity is twice the left's). The left scale shows 8 divisions. How many does the right show?
格数比 = 质量比 × 半径比 × (角速度比)² = 1 × 1 × 4 →: Division ratio = mass ratio × radius ratio × (angular velocity ratio)² = 1 × 1 × 4 → the right ball's force is 4 times the left's: 8 × 4 = 32 divisions.
皮带差两层（右球角速度是左球的三倍），左标尺露 8 格，右标尺露几格？: Belt two steps apart (the right ball's angular velocity is three times the left's). The left scale shows 8 divisions. How many does the right show?
角速度比 3 → 格数比 3² = 9：8 × 9 = 72 格（不是 71，也: Angular velocity ratio 3 → division ratio 3² = 9: 8 × 9 = 72 divisions (not 71, and not 24).
只把长槽的球从 4.0 cm 挪到 8.0 cm（质量、角速度都不动），格数会变: If you only move the long-slot ball from 4.0 cm to 8.0 cm (mass and angular velocity unchanged), the divisions become how many times the original?
半径是一次方：r 比 2 → 格数比 2（16 格 / 8 格）。若是平方关系才: Radius is first power: r ratio 2 → division ratio 2 (16 / 8 divisions). Only a squared relationship would give 4 times.
圆盘上 0.10 m 处一个 0.10 kg 的小物体随圆盘转，角速度 4 ra: A 0.10 kg object 0.10 m from the center turns with a disk at an angular velocity of 4 rad/s. How large is its centripetal force? (textbook p.30, exercise 3)
Fn = mω²r = 0.10 × 4² × 0.10 = 0.16 N（按教: Fn = mω²r = 0.10 × 4² × 0.10 = 0.16 N (the answer calculated from the textbook exercise data).
皮带脱开后，右标尺一格都不露，最直接的原因是: With the belt off, the right scale shows no divisions at all. The most direct reason is
右球太重: The right ball is too heavy
右球不转，没有向心力: The right ball isn't turning, so there's no centripetal force
挡板压力来自球做圆周运动；右塔轮由皮带带转，皮带脱开就没有向心力，套筒不下降、标: The force on the stop comes from the ball moving in a circle; the right pulley is driven by the belt, so with the belt off there's no centripetal force, the sleeve doesn't drop and no divisions show.
用一台向心力演示器，靠两个标尺的格数把 Fn = mω²r 量出来。: Use a centripetal force demonstrator to measure Fn = mω²r from the divisions on two scales.
示意声明：演示器造型、塔轮层数与标尺格数均为教学示意，读数只读格数与比值。: Disclaimer: the demonstrator's shape, number of pulley steps and scale divisions are teaching illustrations; readings are only divisions and ratios.
